item.title: Animal Creation Tutorial
item.description:
Animal Creation Tutorial

Hi future designer! I’m Belgian Shepard also knowed as Octavio17493 and ill teach u how to code with this tutorial, hope you can make your animals with my help, so lets go with basic things first.

1 – Basic things

Ok, before coding ill say u what do u need:

  1. Choose a codename for your animal. This codename mustn’t have spaces, -, ? or rare characters, only letters. Usually designers use as a codename the species of the animal as the first word and the subspecies as the second word, for example, HeronBlue. That’s the code of my blue heron, so you can use letters in UPPER CASE to separate words.
